description: This file implements the DynamoDBMembershipTable class, which manages membership information for Orleans clusters using DynamoDB as the storage backend. It provides methods for initializing the table, reading and writing membership entries, handling table versioning, and cleaning up defunct entries. The class interfaces with DynamoDB through various storage operations and includes logging for tracing and debugging.

classes.name: DynamoDBMembershipTable
classes.description: Implements the IMembershipTable interface for managing Orleans cluster membership states using DynamoDB as storage. Handles initialization, CRUD operations, and cleanup for membership data.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the DynamoDB table and inserts the initial table version if needed.

methods.name: TryCreateTableVersionEntryAsync
methods.description: Attempts to create the initial version record for the table if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: TryCreateTableVersionRecord
methods.description: Creates a new table version record with given version and etag.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries associated with a given cluster ID.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads membership information for a specific silo address.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all membership records, ensuring version consistency.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry with a specific table version.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates existing membership data with concurrency control based on ETag.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a specific silo entry.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a list of SiloInstanceRecord objects to MembershipTableData.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a SiloInstanceRecord into a MembershipEntry.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a MembershipEntry and table version into a SiloInstanceRecord.

methods.name: ConvertPartial
methods.description: Converts a MembershipEntry into a partial SiloInstanceRecord for updates.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes entries for silos that have not sent IAmAlive for a specified duration.

methods.name: SiloIsDefunct
methods.description: Determines if a silo is considered defunct based on last IAmAlive timestamp and current status.
